files.adapted_why: one stage added, this repo's own: `install` asserts the two promises the CMake install rule makes -- that a plain configure defaults the prefix to the user's ~/.local (read out of a throwaway configure's cache, never by installing into the home directory) and that the binary lands in <prefix>/bin and runs from there. It is in CI_DEFAULT_STAGES after `version`, and the stage list in the header block was updated with it. Everything else is the kit template verbatim.

no stage list: the hook calls `tools/ci.sh --require-clean`, so a push runs whatever CI_DEFAULT_STAGES says. The kit ships an explicit list on purpose (so a stage cannot be silently dropped); measured here, the explicit list instead went STALE the moment a stage was added -- the push ran 11 of 12 stages and printed GATE PASSED.
